modules.module_title: preparation for installation

pcs.pc_description: collect plumbing material as per type, size and requirement based on specifications from drawings and plans
correct measurement and marking the dimensions for fabrication on the pipes and fittings making allowances for spring-back, distortion and assembly carefully.

modules.module_title: install plumbing pipes, fittings, sanitary fixtures and CP fittings

pcs.pc_description: cut various types of pipes to appropriate length
bend and form the pipes to specified angle and offsets
prepare pipe ends using techniques such as reaming, leveling, filing, grinding, etc.
joining of different type of pipes using fittings and relevant techniques
construct chambers to accommodate drainage systems as per drawings/specifications
locate various drainage components and its route as per plumbing project plans.
carry out installation of the various components of drainage system such as pipes and their fittings, manholes, traps, cleanouts, catch basins, inspection chamber, soak pit etc.

cutting of physical structures such as walls, concrete in line with correct markings and specifications to perform internal pipe installations
install valves and traps as per plumbing project plan
install fixtures as per specifications without damaging fixtures, pipework and the surrounding conditions etc.
install and secure the sensors for touchless fittings and fixtures in the provided slot and insert batteries for sensor-based fittings and fixtures safely

modules.module_title: post installation operations and checks

pcs.pc_description: clear the area from hazardous substances, debris and waste as per organizational norms and plan tasks in agreement with others while adhering to time commitments
make sure that all inspection openings and covers are being fitted according to relevant standards and job specifications
test the installations for proper functioning
check and rectify faults that are within limits of expertise and escalate higher authorities to rectify it
backfill excavated areas to secure the installation
clear the work area and dispose, reuse or recycle left over materials according to legislation, regulations, codes of practice and job specification
clean and store tools and equipment according to manufacturer’s recommendations and workplace procedures

pcs.pc_description: detect leakages, blockages and damages in plumbing systems (water supply and drainage pipes, fittings and sanitary fixtures) with precise accuracy
conduct hydro test for checking leakages and pressure levels within piping systems by applying desired water pressure to check joints in the systems
identify the causes of low water pressure or water flow problems if applicable

pcs.pc_description: rectify faults in pipework
repair and maintain water supply tanks and valves and remove air locks and blockages in the installed pipelines
repair broken sewer, dripping faucets and fixtures that are not working properly after unclogging drains and drain’s strainer baskets

implement appropriate measures to reduce noise in pipes and fixtures

modules.module_title: monitor the quality of water by various techniques

pcs.pc_description: identify the correct method of water sampling according to the standard operating procedure
obtain the water sample from the source and send samples for laboratory testing
test the water sample for its quality using the water testing kits
identify the TDS level and pH of the water
identify for faecal contamination and heavy metals composition in water
check for the various color coding in kit to ensure the different water quality parameters
perform the various tests with the help of water quality testing
share the water quality testing result with the appropriate higher authorities

modules.module_title: manage the quality of water as per given standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the quality of water is not preceding the water quality standards as per government guidelines.
repair any small damages to the system
check there is no unwanted human intervention or animal intrusion
check whether the area is free from waste disposal and defecation
verify the discharge of water

modules.module_title: maintain ground water resources

pcs.pc_description: check all the flange nuts and bolts, axle bolt and tighten as needed
verify whether hand pump is firm on its base and fix it (if needed), open the cover, clean the pump, dismantle the hand pump for inspection/cleaning and reassemble after inspection of hand pumps
verify rusty patches, clean with a wire brush and apply anticorrosive paint, discharge of water, handle position and clean pump components of hand pumps
operate pump starter and isolation valve for maintenance of tube well and bore well
check if readings on ammeter and voltmeter are normal – stop pump if electric motor is drawing too much current and verify whether adequate water is being delivered
clean the pump house and check for leaks in the rising main
inspect pipes, electric cables, insulation between cables, re-cut corroded or damaged threads, replace badly corroded pipes, de-silt borehole if required
take action as per standard operating procedure to troubleshoot faults occurring in the hand pump, tube or bore well

modules.module_title: maintain spring and surface water sources

pcs.pc_description: check whether the area is free from waste disposal and defecation
check there is no unwanted human intervention or animal intrusion
check intake for clogging and submergence
repair any small damages to the intake system, then dewater and clean the bottom of the spring source
check the water level of the surface water source and de-silt as per requirement

modules.module_title: Install pump and related equipment

pcs.pc_description: understand water supply and drainage systems in rural India
assemble pump components, equipment and prepare the tools, area and materials for the task as per Manufacturer's policy
locate and mark position for inlet and outlet supply connections of pump
fix the pump at the designated location as per instruction and connect the hoses of inlet and outlet supply to the pump
make provisions for electrical and other required connections
install and connect pump components without any damage to pump, fixture, pipe work and the surrounding environment followed by adjusting the pressure/flow as per required supply and demand
check for cracks, defects and anomalies in the pumping apparatus, condition of couplings in the equipment, pumping on both suction and discharge sides
• check the oil level, fuel level, radiator coolant, air release valve and engine condition of a diesel operated pump and prime the same • .
understand the usages and installation of different valves pertaining to plumbing and water management

modules.module_title: Operate the pump

pcs.pc_description: prepare a schedule for running the main pumps and the standby
prime the centrifugal pump before start of operations before ensuring operation of the pump with full efficiency to improve output gain

operate the delivery valve; close bypass valves of reflux valve, sluice valve and butterfly valve; monitor sound, vibration, temperature and other related parameters to ensure smooth operation of the pump
check pump motor alignment and maintain input/output parameters
inspect the pump, related machinery and water supply system for faults, leaks, sparks, improper functioning, wear and tear or evidence of tampering
maintain a record of all pump operations timings, voltage, current, reading on gauges and flow meter, temperature, water level and any problem that occurred during the operations
perform operations on 3-Phase & Single- Phase Pump Operation Connections

modules.module_title: Maintain the pump and related machinery

pcs.pc_description: identify, repair or replace sparking motors, leaking or worn out parts and tighten the foundation bolts
calibrate all vital instruments such as pressure gauge, vaccum gauge, ammeter, voltmeter, watt meters, frequency meter, tachometer and flow meter
conduct performance test of the pump discharge, head, efficiency and troubleshoot faults as per standard operating procedures
conduct various operations on pump control panel board for 3-phase and single phase pump

modules.module_title: Maintain sump and storage tanks

pcs.pc_description: dewater, clean, disinfect and rinse sump and tank as per standard operating procedures
desilt the pump house area and perform leakage test to carry out rectification if needed

modules.module_title: Maintain water meters and flow meters

pcs.pc_description: clean the dirt box or strainer and replace gaskets upon its wear and tear
prevent water seepage into the water meter and clean the chamber where the meter is installed
disassemble and reassemble the water meter for verification or repair
check the range, zero setting of the flow meter, inspect for bearing wear out and deposits in flow meter or corrosion of attached pipes
take action as per standard operating procedure to troubleshoot common faults in water meters and flow meters

modules.module_title: Operate, maintain and repair pipelines and water treatment units

pcs.pc_description: operate water pipelines with required pressure by opening and shutting off the valves gradually
flush the system to clear sediments; service the valve chamber and valves; inspect the pipelines for damage, wear and tear, leakage, entrainment and water hammer and locate the leaks in the pipes
repair damaged pipelines and replace faulty parts like gaskets, valves joints and pipes that are not repairable
start and shut off the filtration process and adjust the rate of filtration as needed by adding chemicals
inspect equipment on a regular basis to ensure proper functioning and adherence to safety standards; monitor operating conditions, meters, gauges and collect and test water and sewage samples
record meter, gauge readings, and operational data to operate equipment
clean and maintain equipment, tanks, filter beds and other work areas

modules.module_title: identification of basic electrical and solar components

pcs.pc_description: identify circuits, wiring diagrams and electrical signages, code specifications to plan wiring layouts and consumption points

use various types of tools, their functions and application for carrying out work and understand rating and current carrying capacity of wires, cables, fuse, switches, sockets, mcbs, elcbs and other electrical accessories
understand use of under-voltage protective devices, choice of setting of protective devices, labelling of protective devices, switches and terminals
check the color coding, connection and identification of conductors, cables and wires, routing of cables, proper selection of conductors, wires and connectors and connection of single pole device

explain various terminologies used in the solar industry and identify different components of Solar PV system and explain its basic operation along with manufacturer's specification sheet of different components
describe and analyze the different types, sizes and specifications of modules, inverters, charge controllers, cables, conduits, junction boxes, solar batteries and allied accessories.

modules.module_title: installation and operations on wiring, mains, distribution and control panel boards

pcs.pc_description: understand layout of main switch, circuit breakers require at main board along with location of main board ensure for utilites service line connection
locate and mark the position of conduit pipe ensures, connections into the structures with proper equipment like measuring tape, hammer, saw, drill machines etc.
cut openings in structures to accommodate conduit pipes or pipe fittings, using hand or power tools

install brackets and hangers to support electrical equipment, install the protective device i.e. fuse, mcb, rccb, mccbs ratings as per the load and join and connect wire to fixtures and components to form circuits
align the main board chassis mounting slots with the lower studs of the Unit box and insert the control panel board (main board) into the unit box so that the main board chassis rests on the studs
insert the mounting screws, spring washers and the free earth lug of the wiring loom, and tighten screws
connect the main line to the control panel box as per given in the manual and check the supply voltage in the control panel
ensure all the operations in the control panel working properly and finally connect the control panel to the main system

modules.module_title: installation and operations of solar pumping systems

pcs.pc_description: check the references of all components of the system to ensure that the installed components are those provided in the design

enhance the performance of SPV water pumping systems, manual or passive or auto tracking system must be used. For manual tracking, arrangement for seasonal tilt angle adjustment and three times manual tracking in a day should be provided.

check orientation and the inclination of the panels, and shadow on the solar PV generator. The orientation and inclination values must be close enough to those that were determined during calculations sizing
install "Surface Motor Pump sets" wherever the “Water table” in the reservoir or the water source from which the water is to be pumped, is within 10 metres of depth
check the cleanliness and protection of the wiring, and its compliance with the standards
inspect civil works (castle, basin, trough, fixing the solar supports etc.) piping, valves and all other important elements that can compromise the sound operation of the system
test the type of pump set to be used which must match the total dynamic head requirement of the site (i.e. the location at which it is installed)

modules.module_title: maintenance of control panel and solar pump systems

pcs.pc_description: perform operations on lubrication and inspection on control panel (including cleanliness)
check that the door is closed and properly clamped and shut
close the pipeline isolation valve during troubleshooting, to prevent reverse flow through the pump
isolate the pump control valve before working on the panel and lock out the pump
perform regular cleaning of solar panels
shut down the pump as soon as the tank is full to avoid overflows
clean the surrounding from tall grass and trees by trimming them to make it free of litter and derbis
